assembly_plan.proof_skeleton_nl: Normalize the original summand using the elementary identity ((q^d;q^d)_k)^2/(q^{2d};q^{2d})_k=(q^d;q^d)_k/(-q^d;q^d)_k, and call the resulting normalized sum S(q). Multiply by the explicit clearing factor D_{d,n}(q)=∏_{s=0}^{n-1}(-q^d;q^d)_s to form H(q)=D(q)S(q). The first substantive input is the strictly weaker lemma that H(q) is a Laurent polynomial divisible by [n]_q; write H(q)=[n]_q J(q). Independently, factor the claimed right-hand side as [n]_q G_{r,n}(q) q^{r(1-n)/2}. The bottleneck lemma then compares the quotient J(q) with D(q)G_{r,n}(q)q^{r(1-n)/2} at every primitive nth root of unity, including first derivative. The abstract double-root criterion upgrades this comparison to Φ_n(q)^2-divisibility of the quotient difference. Multiplying back by [n]_q yields divisibility of D(q)(S(q)-R(q)) by [n]_q Φ_n(q)^2 in the Laurent polynomial ring. Finally, use the coprimality of D(q) with the modulus and the abstract localization-cancellation lemma to cancel D(q) from the congruence, and then replace S(q) by the original sum T(q) via the initial normalization identity. This avoids the previously falsified auxiliary-parameter branch and keeps all hard content isolated in the explicit primitive-root quotient-comparison bottleneck.
